parameters.name: method
parameters.description: the API method to be called

parameters.name: http_conn_id
parameters.description: :ref:`http connection<howto/connection:http>` that has the base API url i.e https://www.google.com/ and optional authentication credentials. Default headers can also be specified in the Extra field in json format.

parameters.name: auth_type
parameters.description: The auth type for the service

parameters.name: tcp_keep_alive
parameters.description: Enable TCP Keep Alive for the connection.

parameters.name: tcp_keep_alive_idle
parameters.description: The TCP Keep Alive Idle parameter (corresponds to ``socket.TCP_KEEPIDLE``).

parameters.name: tcp_keep_alive_count
parameters.description: The TCP Keep Alive count parameter (corresponds to ``socket.TCP_KEEPCNT``)

parameters.name: tcp_keep_alive_interval
parameters.description: The TCP Keep Alive interval parameter (corresponds to ``socket.TCP_KEEPINTVL``)

parameters.name: adapter
parameters.description: An optional instance of `requests.adapters.HTTPAdapter` to mount for the session.
